newsitem.title: NORWAY: Hafslund buys SkanKraft for NOK 86 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hafslund buys SkanKraft for NOK 86 mln.

text.p: Norwegian electricity producer Hafslund ASA said on Thursday it had acquired 100 percent of the shares in SkanKraft Holding AS for 86 million crowns.
Hafslund said the acquisition was part of its strategy to be among the leading power companies in trading and portfolio management in the Nordic area.
"The Skankraft group has a considerable market position and appreciation within trading and portfolio management in the power markets in Norway and Sweden," a statement from Hafslund said.
Skankraft posted net profits of 21 million crowns in 1995. It is headquartered in Oslo with a subsidiary in Stockholm.
